_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 71: 1-6 May 2026. Completes May 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is for entertainment purposes only and that they need to look at this and pray about their own investments and what God is telling them, then says this is what the Lord showed them in prayer and what he believes he was shown.
mentions.quote: entertainment purposes only. pray about your own investments
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and the disclaimer sits directly before the guidance rather than instead of it.

mentions.claim_text: He says these are the people who were holding this back and that they agreed today, and that the Lord said to remember the month of May and pray over the month of May concerning the Clarity Act, which is what they have been praying over.
mentions.quote: Pray over the month of May concerning the Clarity Act
mentions.falsify_match: Movement on the named bill during May, offered here as having happened. Both the earlier telling and the legislative record are checkable.

mentions.claim_text: He plays a clip in which someone says they have made progress and passed the Genius Act and that next week they will mark up the Clarity Act in the Senate, which is a big deal, and asks for an amen.
mentions.quote: Next week, we're going to mark up the Clarity Act in the Senate
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: someone else's statement about a scheduled markup, played as confirmation.

mentions.claim_text: He says the banks threw a fit today and that from what he understands the banks are telling them something, that they will see what happens, that this was on May 1st, and that this is what he told them the Lord said about praying about May.
mentions.quote: The banks threw a fit today. That was on May 1st
mentions.falsify_match: Dated events in the month he named, offered as the fulfilment of the watch-May word.
mentions.falsify_miss: The events do not match what was said.

mentions.claim_text: He says that is interesting and all that he saw right then was very interesting, that he does not know this man, and that the Lord said it does not matter what the Lord said about it.
mentions.quote: I don't know this man, but the Lord said
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a sight about a man he does not know, with the content not given.

mentions.claim_text: He says the economy needs to turn around big time and speaks of the stimulus of that major shot he saw coming to pass, praying over the months of May, June, July and August for a major turnaround for the midterms, and mentions the interest rates.
mentions.quote: praying over the month of May, June, July, August, for a major turnaround
mentions.falsify_match: An economic turnaround across the summer ahead of the midterms.
mentions.falsify_miss: No turnaround. He says the stimulus he saw is already coming to pass.

mentions.claim_text: He says it gets inside your heart and will change you from the inside out, but that if you do not have any scripture you are standing on you will go nowhere, that the rubber has to meet the road, and that the scripture has to back what you are saying.
mentions.quote: if you don't have any scripture that you're standing on, you're going to go nowhere
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is a standard he sets for the audience that the visions themselves are not held to.

mentions.claim_text: He says they start out this month of May with great expectation for a great turnaround in their circumstances, and that whatever they are believing for they are believing for exceedingly abundantly above all they dare ask or think.
mentions.quote: We start out this month of May with great expectation for great turnaround
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: no threshold for a turnaround is given.

mentions.claim_text: He says they have never been in a time like the one they are about to see, and that the Lord said in 2025, on September the 23rd, that they would enter into the point of no return and the point of acceleration, mentioning when they had the UN meeting.
mentions.quote: on September the 23rd you would enter into the point of no return
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: no return from what, and to what, is still not specified eight months on.

mentions.claim_text: He names the 25th Amendment and says he saw a coup, that the Lord said do not forget January 6th, and that a lot of innocent people were accused of things and were in there, naming a pastor out in Amarillo called Brian and saying a lot of good people were accused.
mentions.quote: 25th Amendment. I saw a coup. Don't forget January 6th
mentions.falsify_match: An attempt to remove the president under the 25th Amendment.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a smirk on his face as he was looking towards Taiwan with lights and things coming out of Taiwan, that the Lord said remember this, and that things they are seeing in the news now are alarming because they are in it.
mentions.quote: a smirk on his face as he was looking towards Taiwan
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Because we're in it converts the forecast into a description of present news.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord is warning them to intercede, that he felt in his spirit and is not accusing President Trump and will say it again that this last assassination thing was a hoax and there was something not right about it, but that there is one coming.
mentions.quote: this last assassination thing was a hoax. There was something not right about it
mentions.falsify_match: Evidence that a reported attempt was staged.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He calls a real reported event a hoax while saying he is not accusing anyone, and forecasts a genuine one to follow. Recorded exactly as put.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not and it may not be popular, imagines someone unsubscribing and says well, bye, that he is not there to sway them and they do not have to be there, and that if God has called them to pray with him they should be there and if not he will sail off into the sunset.
mentions.quote: I'm not here to sway you. If not, then I'll sail off into the sunset
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is a softer version of the same move as treating disagreement as trolling.

mentions.claim_text: He says First Amendment rights are going to be challenged in the days ahead especially on social media and closer to 2028 than they realise, concerning elections and censors saying they will not be able to say things.
mentions.quote: closer to 2028 than what you realize
mentions.falsify_match: Speech restrictions tightening on social platforms before 2028.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Closer than you realise moves the date nearer without naming one.

mentions.claim_text: He says what he is seeing is something very similar to September 6th but on a bad bad scale, that there is something very bad, and names George Soros and those who are Antifa, the paid actors and the paid people.
mentions.quote: something very similar to September 6th. But on a bad bad scale
mentions.falsify_match: Large scale organised unrest exceeding a prior event.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. September 6th is not explained, and no date is given for what follows.

mentions.claim_text: He says yes, on the 25th Amendment, asks whether they understand what he is saying, that he is seeing something very dark like January 6th, and prays over his family and his kids and over President Trump.
mentions.quote: I'm seeing something very dark like January 6th
mentions.falsify_match: A constitutional removal attempt accompanied by unrest.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats the breath several times, prays in tongues, and says he sees a cardinal picking at a dove, repeating that a cardinal is picking at the dove, then names an egg horse, the crows and the priests.
mentions.quote: I see the cardinal picking at the dove
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a symbolic image with no interpretation offered, though cardinal and dove both carry obvious church readings.
